card.name: Word-initial J in drug and medical terms
card.fires_on: The letter J (or j) when it starts a word or a name piece, often at the start of a brand name or a term like JAK, JESDUVROQ, JIA, jelly or Ject. It also fires on other short word beginnings such as May and mb.

modes.label: J starting a drug or class name
modes.description: A capital J begins a brand name or a drug class abbreviation such as JAK or JESDUVROQ.

modes.label: J inside device or product names
modes.description: J begins the second part of a compound product name such as SelfJect or ClickJect.

modes.label: Lowercase j in ordinary words
modes.description: A lowercase j or other short word start appears in a common word such as jellies or jostling.
